business_summary: Guangzhou Devotion Thermal Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of clean energy services in China. The company operates through Clean Energy Investment and Operation, Clean Energy Application Equipment, Smart and Comfortable Home Manufacturing and Services, and Financial Leasing and Others segments. It offers clean energy services, such as heat, cooling, electricity, and new energy and clean energy equipment products. The company also provides Little Squirrel gas wall-mounted boiler to home consumption end users for home system solutions, as well as products covering heating, ventilation, fresh air, water purification, and multi-energy integrated systems areas under the Little Squirrel brand name. In addition, it is involved in the production and sale of household and industrial boilers; new energy development, cogeneration and operation, manufacture and sells general-purpose equipment; electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing; as well as production and sales of metal products and heat pumps. Further, the company offers investment activities with own funds; laundry services, professional cleaning, and cleaning and disinfection services; and biomass gas supply. It provides its products and services to industrial and commercial end users. Guangzhou Devotion Thermal Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
